name: MACS J2046.0-3430 (Hubble)
blurb: MACS J2046.0-3430, a massive galaxy cluster, seen by Hubble.
label: macsj204603430-hubble
story: A massive cluster of galaxies, found by its X-ray glow in the MACS survey. Clusters like this act as natural lenses, and Hubble's quick snapshots hunt among them for the bright, stretched arcs of galaxies far behind.

claims.text: MACSJ2046.0-3430 is a target of Hubble program 12884, 'A Snapshot Survey of The Most Massive Clusters of Galaxies'
MACS clusters in the survey are X-ray selected and highly efficient gravitational lenses; a goal is discovering bright giant arcs
MACSJ2046.0-3430 is one of the X-ray selected MACS clusters in the Hubble SNAPshot surveys, with a measured Chandra X-ray luminosity
